name: Strongman Leader
body:
Your strength of arms draws others to your banner.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership, Str 13

Benefit(s): You add your Strength bonus to your leadership score for the purposes of determining how many followers you gain from the Leadership feat. This also allows you to use your Strength in place of your Charisma for prerequisite purposes for other feats that also require Leadership. However, any additional followers obtained in this way must also be martial classes.
